xs.$description: BREAKPOINTS (documentation only — §3.4) CSS custom properties CANNOT be used inside @media queries. These are source-of-truth constants. Use the literal pixel values in @media rules.

skip-link.$description: The skip link must sit above every page chrome element, because it is the first thing a keyboard user reaches. It was `var(--z-skip-link, 9999)` — and --z-skip-link was never defined anywhere, so the fallback was doing all the work and the token name was fiction.

gutter.$description: Component sizes (documented in kits sizing.md) Section gutter — the single horizontal inset for the whole page. 16 mobile / 32 tablet / 48 desktop, per layout-shell.md. Stepped rather than clamped because the spec gives three discrete values, not a curve.

gap.$description: Column gap — layout guides: 16 mobile (4 cols) / 24 tablet (8) / 32 desktop (12).

height.$description: Header formula (owner, 2026-10-21). The nav bar is fixed; the sticky header is only its wrapper, so its height is derived, never set: button 44 (--control-size) = 10 + 24 line + 10 nav bar 68 = 12 + 44 + 12, every breakpoint header = 68 + 2 x outer spacing: 16 mobile -> 100, 20 tablet+ -> 108 The header is sticky and in flow, so the hero, anchor offsets and blog cover subtract --header-height; deriving it keeps them right per breakpoint.

link-size.$description: Nav bar contents (owner, 2026-10-21): every button is 44 tall, which leaves 12 above and below it in the 68 bar - the same 12 the bar keeps at its left and right edge. 16px text

bar-pad.$description: 12px inset inside the bar, every breakpoint

cols.$description: Blog post layout (/blog/[slug]), sm/md/lg tokens: sm here, md and lg in the 768 / 1200 blocks below. sm and md are one centred reading column with the cover under the title; lg splits into a sticky cover (5) and the reading column (7). See kits_design_system/docs/blocks/blog-post.md.

width.$description: Rail, signature and line length (owner, 2026-11-17; sizing.md)
